title: Damian Lillard #37 Prizm Mosaic Blue 2017-18 Portland Trail Blazers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a Damian Lillard #37 Prizm Mosaic Blue 2017-18 Portland Trail Blazers sports trading card. It features the basketball player in his Portland Trail Blazers uniform and is part of the 2020-21 Panini Mosaic set. The card is a parallel/variety, specifically a blue parallel/variety, and is manufactured by Panini. 

It's a great addition to any sports trading card collection, especially for fans of the Portland Trail Blazers or Damian Lillard. The card number is 37 and it represents the 2017-18 season. This item is perfect for anyone looking to add a unique and rare card to their collection.
